mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.partner_plan_code, p.status, v.name, v.data_text, v.data_gb, v.qos_text, v.voice_text, v.sms_text, v.network, v.generation, COALESCE(v.monthly_price, v.charge_price) AS price, v.discount_months, v.price_after_discount, array_to_string(v.supplemented_fields, '|') AS supplemented_fields, v.source_hash FROM plan p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM plan_version pv WHERE pv.plan_id = p.id AND pv.discarded_at IS NULL ORDER BY pv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) v ON TRUE WHERE p.partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND p.plan_type = #{planType} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT id, item_key, value_hash FROM crawl_item WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND url_type = #{urlType} AND status IN ('REVIEW_PENDING', 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED')
SELECT DISTINCT item_key, value_hash, status FROM crawl_item WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND url_type = #{urlType} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'EXCLUDED') AND value_hash IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_item (run_id, partner_code, url_type, item_key, partner_plan_code, plan_id, change_type, status, name, data_text, data_gb, qos_text, voice_text, sms_text, network, generation, price, discount_months, price_after_discount, detail_url, source_url, site_order, changed_fields, warnings, value_hash, collected_on) VALUES (#{runId}, #{partnerCode}, #{urlType}, #{itemKey}, #{partnerPlanCode}, #{planId}, #{changeType}, #{status}, #{name}, #{dataText}, #{dataGb}, #{qosText}, #{voiceText}, #{smsText}, #{network}, #{generation}, #{price}, #{discountMonths}, #{priceAfterDiscount}, #{detailUrl}, #{sourceUrl}, #{siteOrder}, #{changedFields,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{warnings,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{valueHash}, #{collectedOn})
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_item SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', updated_at = now() WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE plan SET last_collected_on = #{collectedOn} WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, partner_plan_code, plan_id, site_order FROM monthly_pick WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND exposed ORDER BY site_order, id
mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_pick SET site_order = #{siteOrder}, collected_on = #{collectedOn} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE monthly_pick SET exposed = FALSE WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS plan_id, partner_plan_code, status FROM plan WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND status <> 'ENDED' AND partner_plan_code IN #{c}
